method.backbone: Trade-style seasonal ridge: forecast y_t-y_(t-12) from release-safe lags, month sin/cos, Spring Festival and March-release controls; add y_(t-12)
method.primary: NBS-retail-scope factor screen ranked through 2019, trained and selected on 2020-2022, with 2023+ reserved as untouched holdout; known lockdown-base years use the direct-factor ARX gate
method.directFactorRace: Expanding-window ridge ARX using last release, 12-month lag, calendar controls and contemporaneous factors; train-window scaling only
method.highFrequency: expanding-window ridge correction of prior out-of-sample backbone errors; alpha=100; cap=1pp; max 2 non-duplicate families
method.informationSet: Each prediction uses target values and model errors strictly before the forecast month. Factor transforms are contemporaneous L0 monthly aggregates.

factorScreeningDecision.statisticalScope: NBS total retail sales of consumer goods covers goods retail and catering revenue; general service consumption and real-estate transactions are outside the target definition.

candidateRoles.primaryFactorNote: Passenger-car wholesale is not counted directly in retail sales; it is retained only as a leading proxy for subsequent vehicle retail.

scopeExclusions.newhome_30_area_yoy: Real-estate transactions are outside total retail sales of consumer goods.
scopeExclusions.secondhand_shenzhen_area_yoy: Second-hand home transactions are outside total retail sales of consumer goods.
scopeExclusions.metro_composite_yoy: Passenger traffic is general service activity, not goods retail or catering revenue.
scopeExclusions.boxoffice_yoy: Cinema ticket revenue is service consumption outside the retail-sales definition.
scopeExclusions.movie_audience_yoy: Cinema attendance is service consumption outside the retail-sales definition.
scopeExclusions.flights_yoy: Air travel is service consumption outside the retail-sales definition.

rankedTopKRace.selectionRule: Choose the lowest 2020-03 to 2022-12 RMSE; 2023+ is untouched holdout and is not used for factor or K selection.

stabilityAnalysis.rollingWindowDefinition: 10 published observations, corresponding to 12 calendar months because January and February have no separate release.
stabilityAnalysis.stabilityGate: A replacement must improve the 2020-2022 selection period, improve the untouched 2023+ holdout overall, and beat the scope-compliant car-retail baseline in at least 75% of holdout calendar years.

productionDecision.reason: The candidate wins only 2 of 4 untouched holdout years; 3 are required, so no deployment candidate is accepted.

dataCompleteness.structuralRule: From 2012 onward, January and February have no separate official monthly retail-sales YoY; NBS publishes a combined Jan-Feb cumulative figure.
